feedback_text: Everything was great!
It was easy at the time to park car outside. Clean rooms, helpful staff.
Super friendly and helpful staff. The hotel is in a great location with clean, modern rooms and a very nice breakfast.

The breakfast offered by an independent service does not correspond quantitatively and qualitatively to the known levels of Cypriot hospitality and gastronomy,and the price of 12 for breakfast is much more expensive than the reasonable value (in terms of quality and quantity) of the offered product!
The room smelled of sewage, it should never be like this. This is a definite minus and prevents coming again.
Very warm and caring welcome. The room was very well equipped, clean, comfortable... I was very happy.

Great location. 10 minutes by bus from and to the airport. 10 minutes walk to the beach and cafes by the beach. It takes 40 minutes to walk along the promenade to the city, but it's nice. The hotel is good, the staff is friendly.
The room is very very small (2 beds at 18 meters), but at the same time, clean and tidy.  Most importantly, do not go to nearby cafes/restaurants. Never had such a terrible dinner before.
The hotel is not far from the airport, but a bit far from city center.
There is no supermarket open 24 hours close to the hotel.
Access to the airport is close but not so easy with the bus, when you do not know
Wonderful people on reception and in the restaurant :) always smiling and glad to help
Enjoyed an excellent overnight stay before heading the the airport. Loads of bars and restaurants 5 mins walk away on the beach. Really friendly and accomodating hosts.
Large spacious suite. Comfortable beds. Good for large family 5 people. Light interior.
nice, clean and neat. super sweet hosts

Modern hotel with good facilities. Although small, the room was comfortable. However, the bathroom was a good size and well appointed. Breakfast as an extra was good.\nThe hotel is about 100m from the  bus stop.

We stayed for a week and had a comfortable experience. The room was cleaned daily, and fresh towels were provided regularly. The minibar was well-stocked, though we preferred to use the fridge for our own items. The hotel staff was accommodating and ensured a smooth stay. It's conveniently located, with the Larnaca promenade just a short walk away. Ideal for a short and pleasant stay.
Very nice and clean room.

Arrival at 5am, just for one night.The owners left us clear and precise information for our arrival, sending us photos.Cleanliness, distance from the airport, quality of bedding, size of the room, bottle of water available.Sympathy of the owners in the morning who made the effort to speak French to us.We recommend eyes closed.
The hotel is very clean and close to the airport. Simple and comfortable rooms, you can see that there is care in the place.
